# Bothy's label set, one label per line:
#
#     name | colour | description
#
# Applied to the repository by .github/workflows/labels.yml on every push that
# touches this file, using that workflow's own token. So the labels need no
# personal access token and no admin rights to stay in step with the repo: edit
# this file and the labels follow, which is how a project should keep them.
#
# The set is deliberately specific to this project rather than the generic
# default. The two problems Bothy has not solved (proving which weights ran, and
# reaching a host behind a home router) are labels, so they can be filtered for.
# So is `unverified`, for the things CI cannot check.
#
# Colours are the GitHub defaults where a name matches one, so nothing here looks
# out of place next to another repository's labels.
bug|d73a4a|Something is broken, or a refusal that should not have happened
documentation|0075ca|README, PROTOCOL.md, docs/design.md
duplicate|cfd3d7|Already reported
enhancement|a2eeef|A new capability
good first issue|7057ff|Self-contained, no GPU required
help wanted|008672|Extra attention welcome
invalid|e4e669|Not reproducible, or not about Bothy
question|d876e3|A question about how Bothy works
wontfix|ffffff|Deliberately not doing this
design|5319e7|A disagreement with, or a change to, the design
protocol|0e8a16|Touches the wire contract in PROTOCOL.md
digests|1d76db|Model identity, hashing, verification
engine|fbca04|An adapter, or support for another inference engine
registry|c5def5|Discovery, heartbeats, the registry service
metering|bfd4d2|Usage counting, caps, rate limits
docker|006b75|The image, the compose profiles, the devnet
security|d93f0b|Keys, exposure, the threat model
reachability|d4c5f9|Connecting a host behind NAT — tunnels, transport, relays
anonymity|c2e0c6|Hiding addresses. Deferred, not rejected
payments|fef2c0|Metering to billing. Not now, but the door is open
unverified|ededed|Needs a check CI cannot perform
